subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — proposed cadence & skip-day fallback

Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing & format

Hi Olga,

We’re coming up on our renewal and would like to combine the QBR with a roadmap demo focused on the expanded inference features (dedicated capacity + private deployment). Ideally we’d do a 90-minute session: 45 minutes executive roadmap + 45 minutes technical deep dive.

Executive availability: Tue/Wed next week (11/10–11/11) mornings PST. Engineering prefers 11/12 afternoon PST.

Two asks:
- Can you propose a primary slot and a built-in fallback pattern in case execs can only make brief windows?
- Can your SE run a short technical dry-run beforehand to validate SAML SSO and our staging keys?

Thanks — looking forward.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
CTO, GreenWave Health
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — timing & format

Thanks Daniel — good context. Proposal below:

Primary: Wed 2026-11-11 09:00–10:30 PST (exec 09:00–09:45 / tech 09:45–10:30)
Skip-day fallback: if execs can’t do a contiguous 90m block, we’ll run a 60-minute exec summary (recorded) and schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive the following week.

Why skip-day cadence: it keeps an uninterrupted exec window when leadership is tight, but ensures engineers still get full technical time. We’ll add an explicit dry-run 48 hours before the demo for SAML/keys.

Attaching a draft agenda and a dry-run checklist for Mateo — can you confirm the SAML test window and whether you can provide a staging SSO account?

If that works I’ll send calendar invites with guarded slots and include a brief pre-read.

Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

On 11/01/2026 11:03 AM, Olga Petrov wrote:
> Attaching a draft agenda and a dry-run checklist for Mateo — can you confirm the SAML test window and whether you can provide a staging SSO account?

Thanks — we can run the dry-run on Mon 11/09 or Tues 11/10 between 10:00–12:00 PST. For the SAML validation I’ll need:
- A staging SP metadata file or IdP test endpoint
- One test user with SSO access (preferably an org-admin)
- Any IP allowlists for your staging environment

Potential blocker to call out now: GreenWave’s staging certificates refresh nightly at 02:00 UTC; if the dry-run account is created earlier the provisioning TTL may expire. If that’s the case we should request a short-lived test token on the day of the dry-run.

I’ve attached a short checklist that covers token exchange, SSO, model access, and sample inference runs.

Mateo Alvarez
